name: Loss Aversion
axiom: Losses weigh on choices more than equivalent gains do.
trigger: A change is refused for what it might lose, not weighed by what it gains.
checklist: Show the loss and the gain of a change side by side, in the same units.
Describe what staying costs as plainly as what moving costs.
Test whether the framing moved the decision, not only the preference.

antiPattern.violation: A migration is presented only as what could break, so nobody approves it.
antiPattern.remediation: State the risk and the gain together, with the same visibility and the same units.

parametricParams.caption: A LOSS OUTWEIGHS THE SAME-SIZED GAIN

academicOrigin.title: Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk
